thought: The Political Instructor is a distinct role from the combat soldiers - he's an ideological and inspirational leader rather than a field commander. Comparing with others: Ma Baoyu has binoculars and thick eyebrows, Ge Zhenlin has rolled sleeves and square jaw, Song Xueyi has a round face, Hu Delin has an askew cap, Hu Fucai has a satchel bag. The Political Instructor is described as having 'sharp facial features' and 'intellectual depth.' The most distinctive and historically accurate feature would be wire-rimmed glasses, which immediately mark him as educated and intellectual - rare among soldiers and setting him apart from all combat personnel. Combined with sharp, angular facial features and a small notebook tucked into his belt (political instructors kept records and gave speeches), he becomes instantly recognizable as the political/ideological leader.
distinctive_features: Wire-rimmed round glasses, sharp angular facial features, small notebook tucked into belt
prompt: Full body portrait of an Eighth Route Army political instructor standing in a dignified, upright stance, embodying ideological conviction and inspirational leadership. The man has distinctively sharp, angular facial features with high cheekbones and a defined face structure. Most prominently, he wears wire-rimmed round glasses that immediately mark him as educated and intellectual, setting him apart from combat soldiers. A small leather-bound notebook is tucked into his belt at the waist, symbolizing his role in political education and record-keeping. He wears a blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniform jacket that is slightly longer in cut than combat tunics, standard military cap with red star emblem worn precisely, brown leather belt, dark cotton pants, and clean cloth shoes. No rifle, but a holstered pistol at his side befitting his officer status. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored deep burgundy background with high contrast separation, creating a dignified silhouette. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front, casting shadows that accentuate his sharp facial contours while creating a subtle glint on his glasses lenses. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation earth tones - muted slate blues, weathered browns, dusty grays. The lighting emphasizes the intellectual quality conveyed by the glasses and the texture of the notebook at his belt. Solemn, resolute, and inspirational atmosphere, reflecting the ideological depth required for political leadership in 1941 wartime China. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong contrast between light and shadow, emphasizing the harsh dignity and epic gravitas of historical events. Deep focus keeping the entire figure sharp from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys intellectual authority, unwavering conviction, and the power to inspire through words and ideology. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Chinese Eighth Route Army political officer appearance and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Officer with wire-rimmed glasses and notebook at belt
